 Order

This petition is filed by the petitioner - accused under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in Spl.Case (SC/ST) No.21/2021 registered for the offence the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 354(B), 323, 504, 506 read with 34 of IPC, Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w), 3(2)(v-a) of SC/ST, Act.
2.

During the pendency of this petition both the petitioner and respondent No.2 have appeared before the Court and filed an application - IA No.1/2024, under Section 320(3) of Cr.P.C. along with joint affidavit to compound the offence.
3. The petitioner and respondent No.2 are husband and wife and their marriage is a love marriage and got one child out of the wedlock.
4. Considering these facts and circumstances, whereas the petitioner and respondent No.2 are husband and wife and NC: 2024:KHC:6393 want to lead married life happily
, I.A.No.1/2024 is allowed permitted to compound the offence.

Consequently, the Criminal Petition is also allowed and the proceedings in Spl.Case (SC/ST)No.21/2021 on the file of Principal District and Sessions Court,
Davanagere, registered for the offence the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 354(B), 323,
504, 506 read with 34 of IPC, Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 3(1)(r),
3(1)(s), 3(1)(w), 3(2)(v-a) of SC/ST, Act against the petitioner is hereby quashed.
